name: dev.codevisor/test-events
title: Test Events
description: Emits test events on demand for developing event subscriptions.

tools.name: emit
tools.description: Publish a test event to every open stream and to the poll buffer.

tools.name: list_recent
tools.description: List the most recent test events, oldest first.

tools.name: show_events
tools.description: Show the most recent test events in an interactive view.

events.name: test.ping
events.description: A test ping published by the emit tool.

events.name: test.counter
events.description: A counter tick, published by the emit tool or the optional interval timer.

skills.name: test-events
skills.description: Exercise Codevisor plugin events end to end with the test-events plugin.
